title: Every kbmon surface shows the same summaries, and says why a panel is missing
goal: the live view, --once, --status, the kb_monitor_status tool, the kbmon pane and the receipt show the needs-you line and the session summaries from one implementation; a panel that is absent or timed out says its own reason; the host panel's ceiling bars share a row only where the row fits; this clone's own processes are not counted as another clone's load; a docs question about cost, a session or kbmon stays a kb lookup
